main_measure.name: drift-adjusted position-weighted next-bar return after thin-volume up bars
main_measure.threshold: above 0 with t-stat >= 2.0 to confirm; <= 0 with t-stat <= 0 to reject

supporting_check.name: largest-third minus smallest-third mean drift-adjusted next-bar drop, by |position|

decided_by: The short earns 0 or less after the drift adjustment with a t-stat of 0 or below.
reading: Qualifying bars are rows with regime 'mean_reversion' that have a next close in the same window. The position is postRebalance_current_allocation, the position actually held. Each case is position x (next-bar return minus that window's unconditional mean next-bar return), pooled over all windows. Thirds are a stable sort on |position| split with array_split.
